title: Modules
content:
Modules are reusable packages of Terraform configuration that group related resources together. They allow you to abstract and share infrastructure patterns across projects and teams. Every Terraform configuration is technically a module; the directory you run Terraform from is called the root module.

Visit the following resources to learn more:

- [@official@Modules Overview - Configuration Language | Terraform](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/modules)
- [@official@Modules - Terraform Registry](https://registry.terraform.io/browse/modules)
